walkthroughs.body_html:
Group 1: down the group, easier to lose outer electron.

Group 7: down the group, harder to gain outer electron.

Li - crimson, Na - yellow, K - lilac.

Ca - orange-red, Cu - green-blue.

Chloride: AgCl white.

Bromide: AgBr cream. Iodide: AgI yellow.

Sulfate: BaSO4 white. Carbonate: CO2 cloudy limewater.
